text:
maya: Hey team — requesting a temporary exception to the prompt/eval gating for the 11:00 UTC release window. Our eval run has one flaky prompt group that’s blocking promotion, but the regressions look limited to style variance, not correctness. We need the fix in prod to unblock a customer-facing rollback mitigation.
srini (EngLead): Can you paste the failing examples and explain why they’re flaky rather than a real regression?
maya (PM): Sure — failing set attached inline. Most failures are low-confidence score diffs and one example where prompt tokenization changed ordering 
```
FAIL: prompt_id=42 — expected intent: "confirm", got: "confirm" (tokenized order diff)
Metric delta: rougeL -0.02, model_confidence -0.06
```
Looks like a shaping/regression in whitespace handling after the tokenizer tweak. We rolled a quick patch that fixes tokenization but it hasn’t gone through full eval due to time.
sarah (QA): If it’s just tokenization whitespace, we can accept with compensating checks: smoke-run on prod prompts, extended quality traces, and a 30m guarded canary. Need signoff from infra and eng lead.
omar (Infra): We can do a staged rollout: 5% traffic for 30m with extra sampling to the QA bucket. I’ll enable verbose tracing and route copies to staging log stream. Deploy-bot: scheduled rollout window requested for 2026-03-20T11:00:00Z -> 2026-03-20T12:00:00Z, canary=5%.
maya (PM): Also proposing to pin previous model variant for Dedicated customers for 24h fallback, to avoid SLA churn.
srini (EngLead): I’m comfortable with an exception if: (1) canary at 5% for 30m, (2) automated smoke tests pass (no intent-level regressions on golden set), (3) auto-rollback trigger set to any intent-level regression > 0.1 on the eval metrics.
sarah (QA): I’ll run the golden set against the hotfix and monitor. If anything beyond whitespace drift shows up, I’ll request immediate rollback.
deploy-bot: canary rollout created: version r3.2.7-hotfix-tokenize -> 5% traffic at 11:00 UTC, auto-rollback threshold: intent_regression>=0.10, monitoring: qa/smoke, trace: verbose.
omar (Infra): I’ve enabled extra logs and sampling. I’ll also pin prior variant on redirect route for Dedicated: previous=r3.2.6.
maya (PM): Notifying support and CSMs in #customer-success; adding a short note to release notes: "Fix whitespace tokenization causing ordering variance in small fraction of prompts; guarded rollout to validate fixes."
release-bot: release note snippet added to changelog: "r3.2.7-hotfix-tokenize — guarded canary to address tokenization ordering; QA monitoring enabled."
srini (EngLead): I approve exception under the listed controls. @sarah @omar if you confirm readiness we can proceed at 11:00.
sarah (QA): Ready. I’ll be monitoring the QA dashboard and will post immediate update.
omar (Infra): Ready and watching infra traces.
maya (PM): Thanks — rolling forward. If anyone sees an unexpected intent regression call it out immediately in this thread and we’ll hit rollback. :raised_hands:
